[[File:Ryan Werntz portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Ryan Werntz.]]
'''Ryan Werntz''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 13 FL from Gainesville, Va. The slot is listed as Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He joined Decipher's volunteer program in April 1996, having directed Magic tournaments before.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
Greetings fellow Rebels. Red 13 reporting as ordered.

In April of 1996, I happened upon a rare opportunity. A company called Decipher was looking for a few good individuals to help them promote their newly popular Star Wars CCG.

The players have always been the reason that, to quote Kendrick, "I love this game!"<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
